name: 19-turn-index-recovery
checks: Crash right after spawn: readers report interrupted, never running, and an agent follow sends the derived turn.ended; the next turn appends the missing end line without rerunning the harness. A torn tail is never a line and numbering continues. Run four turns and the first journal expires while the turn keeps its outcome. Unit tests cover not_started after the start line only, trim past 2000 turns, and a complete line whose fsync failed read as committed (a_complete_line_whose_fsync_failed_reads_as_committed_and_derives_right).
